Company renamed from WhiteHawk Income Corporation to WhiteHawk Minerals Corp. concurrent with IPO closing.
Final IPO prospectus (Form 424B4) filed with the SEC; not yet pulled into this ticker's evidence folder [HUMAN REVIEW].
